frase_gancho.texto: The old neighborhood of La Conchita and the flavors that keep it alive.

introduccion_narrativa.texto: West of the plaza lies La Conchita, one of the oldest neighborhoods in Coyoacán. Here you'll find a chapel, houses with legends, and a table set with cantinas, cafés and churros.
